entities.summary: Sir Thomas Clifford Allbutt KCB, MA, MD, ScD, FRS was an English physician best known for his role as president of the British Medical Association 1920, for inventing the clinical thermometer, and for supporting Sir William Osler in founding the History of Medicine Society.
